name: disjoint_noise_heavy_holdout
description: Disjoint-topic noise-heavy held-out scenario, generated 2026-04-18 via Gemini 2.0 Flash. Topics span accessibility, billing, i18n, ml_ops, mobile_ops, observability, product_rollouts, security_response -- intentionally DISJOINT from the knowledge_update* training scenarios (no cache, auth, db, deploy). Used to measure v7 generalization on noise-heavy content it did NOT see in training. Replaces the contaminated knowledge_update_50t eval -- see experiments/nanogpt/contamination_audit.json and H_v9_pragmatic in HYPOTHESES.md for context.
